invented_facts: The 30B model required 128 GB for meaningful performance; the tested 64 GB Vantage Pro 16 reached 15 tokens/second.
Image generation lagged behind 'competitors'; the paper tested only one Vantage Pro 16 configuration.
The body says sustained runs were approximately 10–12% slower, but the reported declines were about 12% for Aurora and 9% for Vantage.
notes: The summary omits essential caveats, including the single Vantage configuration, 4-bit quantization and unevaluated output quality. It also leaves out numerous test conditions and does not clearly distinguish the video-playback battery rating from an AI-workload rating. The word limit and three-bullet structure are met.
